preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The length of the string is between 1 and 40, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: s consists of lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: The string consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.description: The value of k is between 0 and n, inclusive.
The string after the operation is sorted alphabetically.

postconditions.expression: not exists k' < k such that after_sorting(s, k') == sorted(s)
postconditions.description: k is the minimum value that allows the string to be sorted alphabetically.
